summary: Tested 4 P0 features (Knowledge Graph, Financials, Decision Simulation, Evidence drill-down) end-to-end. Backend: 15/16 P0 pytest cases pass (the 1 failure is data-pollution, not a code bug — AI-003 was sanctioned by earlier action tests, so shadow_exposure returns 0). Frontend: KG page, Evidence modal, and Overview financial cards all work perfectly. CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: Simulate button click sets simRisk state but Decisions.jsx never renders <SimulationModal /> — the JSX element is missing, so simulation-modal never opens.

minor.issue: Returns 0 matches because AI-003 was sanctioned by previous test_new_features.py actions test — not a code bug, but the preset silently returns [] on a fresh but stateful org. Consider resetting or seeding an additional shadow AI to keep this preset meaningful after actions run.

ui_bugs.issue: SimulationModal is imported and simRisk state exists, but the <SimulationModal risk={simRisk} onClose={()=>setSimRisk(null)}/> JSX element is NEVER rendered in the return tree. Clicking [data-testid='simulate-REC-001'] updates state but nothing appears on screen. Add the component render (e.g., {simRisk && <SimulationModal risk={simRisk} onClose={()=>setSimRisk(null)}/>}) inside the top-level div.

integration_issues.issue: Backend POST /api/simulate works (verified via pytest — returns exposure_before/after, ROI, payback, health_delta), but the frontend Simulate button never opens simulation-modal because the modal JSX is missing from Decisions.jsx. Entire feature is unreachable from the UI.

action_items: CRITICAL: Add <SimulationModal risk={simRisk} onClose={()=>setSimRisk(null)}/> render inside Decisions.jsx return JSX (after the outer div children). Without it the P0 Decision Simulation UI is dead.
Optional: Make shadow_exposure preset resilient — either reseed AI-003 as shadow after CASB action runs, or seed a second shadow AI so the preset always demonstrates value.
critical_code_review_comments: Decisions.jsx: dead-code import — SimulationModal imported but never rendered. Lint rule (no-unused-vars for JSX-adjacent imports) would have caught this.
KnowledgeGraph.jsx: preset button UI is clean, ReactFlow renders 25-node graph with correct type coloring and highlight overlay — good work.

EvidenceModal.jsx: fully renders the Metric→Calc→Source→Evidence→Control→Risk→Framework→Owner chain plus FAIR ALE — verified visually with CR-002 ($8M inherent / $4.8M residual / $3.7M risk-adjusted).
routes._build_graph is org-scoped and re-derived each call (no caching) — fine at 25 nodes but could add response cache header for large orgs.

shadow_exposure preset silently returns [] when no shadow AI exist — consider returning explanation like 'No shadow AI currently discovered — good posture' instead of the current '0 shadow AI system(s) discovered...' which is passable but ambiguous.

success_rate.backend: 94% (15/16 P0 cases; the failure is environmental data pollution not a code bug)
success_rate.frontend: 75% (3 of 4 P0 features work end-to-end; Simulation modal never renders)

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent adds the missing <SimulationModal/> render in Decisions.jsx, re-run the Playwright block that clicks [data-testid='simulate-REC-001'] and asserts [data-testid='simulation-modal'] visibility + [data-testid='sim-slider']. Backend endpoints for all 4 P0 features are green. Pytest file: /app/backend/tests/test_p0_features.py.
rca of the issue: Decisions.jsx sets simRisk state on button click (line 69) but there is no <SimulationModal risk={simRisk} onClose={()=>setSimRisk(null)}/> in the JSX return tree. React never mounts the component, so the modal DOM never appears. Fix is a 1-line addition inside the outer <div className='rise space-y-6'>: {simRisk && <SimulationModal risk={simRisk} onClose={()=>setSimRisk(null)}/>}
